                    [32m'Anything imported here will be available in the default Reflex import as `rx.*`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Dynamic Imports\n'[39m +
                    [32m'---------------\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Reflex utilizes dynamic imports, or lazy loading, to reduce startup/import times.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'With this approach, imports are delayed until they are actually needed. We use\n'[39m +
                    [32m'the `lazy_loader` library(https://github.com/scientific-python/lazy_loader) to achieve this.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'How it works\n'[39m +
                    [32m'--------------\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`lazy_loader.attach` takes two optional arguments: `submodules` and `submod_attrs`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `submodules` typically points to directories or files to be accessed.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `submod_attrs` defines a mapping of directory or file names as keys with a list\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  of attributes or modules to access.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Example directory structure:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'reflex/\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    |_ components/\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            |_ radix/\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                |_ themes/\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    |_ components/\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        |_ box.py\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'To add `box` under the `rx` namespace (`rx.box`), add the relative path to `submod_attrs` in\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`reflex/__init__.py` (this file):\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```python\n'[39m +
                    [32m'lazy_loader.attach(\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    submodules={"components"},\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    submod_attrs={\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        "components.radix.themes.components.box": ["box"]\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                    [32m')\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'This implies that `box` will be imported from `reflex/components/radix/themes/components/box.py`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'To add box under the `rx.radix` namespace (`rx.radix.box`), add the relative path to the\n'[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```python\n'[39m +
                    [32m'lazy_loader.attach(\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    submodules = {"themes"},\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    submod_attrs = {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        "themes.components.box": ["box"]\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                    [32m')\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Note: It is important to specify the immediate submodules of a directory in the submodules\n'[39m +
                    [32m"argument to ensure they are registered at runtime. For example, 'components' for reflex,\n"[39m +
                    [32m"'radix' for components, 'themes' for radix, etc.\n"[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Pyi_generator\n'[39m +
                    [32m'--------------\n'[39m +
                    [32m'To generate `.pyi` files for `__init__.py` files, we read the `_SUBMODULES` and `_SUBMOD_ATTRS`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'attributes to generate the import statements. It is highly recommended to define these with\n'[39m +
                    [32m'the provided annotations to facilitate their generation.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'Aliases\n'[39m +
                    [32m'------------\n'[39m +
                    [32m'This is a special case to specify an alias for a component.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'As an example, we use this typically for `rx.list` where defining `list` attribute in the list.py\n'[39m +
                    [32m"overshadows python's list object which messes up the pyi generation for `list.pyi`. As a result, aliases\n"[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    submod_attrs={\n'[39m +
